CFB|5121721|ryd.note: The app shows Middlebrook missing Virginia's last game and no explanation or status for Cal was found, so his availability is unconfirmed.

CFB|4918414|ryd.note: Edwards leads Kansas with 596 rushing yards; the game preview lists no injury for him.

NFL|00-0033119|pyd.note: Recently acquired by trade, Brissett is reported to start Monday vs. the Chargers with Lamar Jackson out indefinitely (thumb); it will be his first Ravens start. Consensus line matches 214.5.

CFB-week.summary: Week 11 is headlined by Michigan at Oregon, USC at Indiana, Texas at LSU and Ole Miss at Oklahoma. Miami hosts Duke without star WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery), and Texas Tech rides new starter Tommy Castellanos into Stillwater after benching Will Hammond.

NBA-DET-at-MIA-1115.summary: No current report for Saturday could be found: search results were from earlier seasons, so Klay Thompson (ankle) and Pelle Larsson (illness) remain unconfirmed after missing Friday. Detroit is still without Jalen Duren and Isaiah Joe per the packet.

NFL-BUF-at-NYJ-1115.summary: Buffalo's RT Spencer Brown (ankle) is doubtful and CB Benford questionable; TE Kincaid was limited Wednesday but carries no final designation in the packet. For the Jets, Garrett Wilson returned to limited practice after a concussion and is questionable with one step left in the protocol, while LB Trevin Wallace is out.

NFL-HOU-at-CLE-1115.summary: Watson, cleared from concussion protocol, reclaims the Browns start after Shedeur Sanders started last week; Monken backs him week to week. WR Denzel Boston (toe) was in a boot and is questionable. Texans RB David Montgomery practiced Friday after a month out and is questionable; Hunter and Al-Shaair are out.

NFL-JAX-at-TEN-1115.summary: Titans lose WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), LG Peter Skoronski, LBs Cody Barton and Anthony Hill Jr. and P Tommy Townsend; RB Tyjae Spears is questionable after a full Friday. Jaguars sit S Jessie Bates and DT Jordan Davis; RB Bhayshul Tuten missed two practices with an ankle/foot issue but practiced Friday and has no designation, and WR Jakobi Meyers (ankle) went DNP then limited.

NFL-LA-at-ARI-1115.summary: Rookie Carson Beck makes his NFL debut for Arizona after Gardner Minshew went to IR, and the Cardinals are without WRs Michael Wilson, Kendrick Bourne and Jalen Brooks plus C Froholdt and G Gaines. The Rams are without Puka Nacua and Davante Adams and LG Steve Avila. Jeremiyah Love remains on IR.

NFL-MIA-at-IND-1115.summary: No current-week Colts or Dolphins reports beyond the packet could be confirmed: searches returned 2024-2025 articles and the Colts official injury page was not reachable. Packet shows Indianapolis without TE Mo Alie-Cox and RT Jalen Travis, with TE Will Mallory questionable; Miami without C Aaron Brewer.

NFL-MIN-at-GB-1115.summary: Kirk Cousins, traded to Minnesota on Nov. 10, is the expected starter with Kyler Murray (hamstring) out and Carson Wentz limited by an ankle; LaFleur said he expects Cousins to start while O'Connell had not fully committed midweek. Minnesota is also without TE Hockenson and WR Jennings. Green Bay loses Josh Jacobs (finger surgery) and backup TE Josh Whyle, leaving the backfield to Lloyd, Kaleb Johnson and possibly Chris Brooks.

NFL-NE-at-DET-1115.summary: Joint report: Lions WR St. Brown (ribs) limited all week and questionable, RB Vaki DNP Wed/Thu; Lions without C Mays, CB Reed, S Joseph. Patriots without C/G Ben Brown, CB Davis, RB Henderson; Stevenson (knee tendon) questionable amid reports he would miss weeks, A.J. Brown limited all week.

NFL-PIT-at-CIN-1116.summary: Steelers come off a bye nearly healthy: only DT Derrick Harmon (IR return) is questionable, and Darnell Washington, T.J. Watt and Cam Heyward were rest days that ended with full Friday practices; WRs Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson remain on IR. Bengals rule out S Kyle Dugger and list CB Jalen Davis, G Brian Parker II and WR Andrei Iosivas as doubtful.

NFL-SEA-at-LV-1115.summary: Darnold (quad/ribs) is out again and Drew Lock makes a second straight start while managing an oblique injury, with Jalen Milroe as backup. Seattle is also without LT Cross, G Nelson and DT Leonard Williams. Raiders' Bowers, Jeanty and Thornton were seen at Wednesday practice.

NFL-SF-at-DAL-1115.summary: Pickens (hamstring) missed last week but practiced and has no designation for Sunday. Dallas lost TE Ferguson and RB Goodson for multiple weeks, with Spann-Ford and possibly Schoonmaker at TE and Abanikanda the likely No. 2 back. 49ers remain without Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) and Aiyuk.

SOCCER-day.summary: No confirmed absences among listed players; all national-team players checked are in their November squads. Vasco's Gabriel Pereira may lose his spot with Saldivia back from suspension; Blackpool travel without several attackers.

NBA-ATL-at-CHI-1114.summary: Both starting guards are questionable: Chicago's Norman Powell (shoulder, two straight missed games) and Atlanta's Kingston Flemings (back). If Flemings sits, CJ McCollum likely returns to the Hawks' starting lineup; Chicago is also without Caleb Wilson for weeks.

NBA-CLE-at-MIA-1114.summary: Giannis is probable with the right wrist sprain he has played through since early November (40+ minutes on Nov 4). Cleveland is without Sam Merrill; Klay Thompson and Pelle Larsson are questionable for Miami. No minutes limit reported for Giannis.

NBA-GS-at-SA-1114.summary: Golden State is without Stephen Curry (oblique tear diagnosed Nov 12, re-evaluated in two weeks) and Brandon Williams (hamstring, at least a week), plus Porzingis, Butler and Moody; Bassey is expected to play. San Antonio lists Vassell and Fox as questionable and Tobias Harris out.

NBA-MEM-at-NO-1114.summary: New Orleans is thin on the wing: Trey Murphy (knee) and Bennedict Mathurin (thumb) are both doubtful and Watford is out, which leaves more shots for Zion Williamson and Dejounte Murray, with Saddiq Bey, Jordan Poole and Karlo Matkovic absorbing minutes. Memphis is without centers Zach Edey and Quinten Post.

NBA-NY-at-IND-1114.summary: The Knicks list no injuries for Friday in Indiana. The Pacers remain without Haliburton (hamstring), Sheppard and Furphy, and starting wing Aaron Nesmith is questionable after leaving Wednesday's game with a sore right knee. Indiana's preview lists Landry Shamet, not Josh Hart, among the Knicks' probable starters.

NBA-OKC-at-LAC-1114.summary: Ajay Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for OKC after missing Wednesday, when Alex Caruso started in his place; Jaylin Williams (back) is out again, so Aday Mara keeps starting next to Isaiah Hartenstein. The Clippers are without Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal and Niederhauser.

NBA-POR-at-SAC-1114.summary: Portland is without Ja Morant, Vit Krejci and Shaedon Sharpe, with Chris Youngblood listed out on the app report but day-to-day on another injury feed. Sacramento is without Maxime Raynaud and Ben Simmons, with Precious Achiuwa questionable (ankle). No news found that changes the targets' roles.

NBA-UTAH-at-HOU-1114.summary: Utah is missing Markkanen (hand, a month+), Jaren Jackson Jr. and Nurkic, so Josh Green starts and Keyonte George (back from an ankle sprain) carries the scoring. Houston opens Marcus Smart's three-game suspension and is still without centers Capela and Adams.

NFL-CAR-at-NO-1115.summary: Both teams' main backs got rest days Wednesday and practiced fully Thursday (Hubbard, Kamara). Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) is practicing off New Orleans' IR, which could crowd the Saints' backfield, while CJ Donaldson and center Erik McCoy have missed both practices. Noah Fant was upgraded to full participation (back), and Carolina's Jonathon Brooks practiced fully.
